note: Old Horn, the Antlered Alpha (unit identity, Wildmoot; Legendary; polar bear entity on the hound rig, own bear boxes): a huge low bear with a high hump and neck ruff under a 30 px antler rack of branching tines, a shaggy bark coat, a grey scarred muzzle, clay warpaint and clay-glow eyes, a bone-and-feather mantle bound in ochre over the shoulder hump on a team-colour hide mantle. No war-banner (an open question for Kort). Tier II: bone brow plate, heavy pauldrons, gorget, greaves, rack bands, long fangs; tier III: a tusk crest on the hump, skull trophies and a brow skull, greave and pauldron tusks, ochre-dipped tines, sabre tusks. No back flag.
